title: Lucia — Fine Art Print (2025)
caption: Museum-grade fine art print · 30 × 40 cm · 2025
description_html:
Lucia is a museum-grade fine art print of the original pastel painting created by Manuel Cech in 2025. The work portrays the fragile balance between light and decay — a meditation on endurance, identity, and the quiet persistence of empathy beneath silence.

Rendered in soft pastel at a scale of 30 × 40 cm, it transforms fragility into structure. The print preserves every texture of the original surface, translating gesture and stillness into permanence.

title: Mirror — Digital Fine Art Print (2025)
caption: Museum-grade fine art print · 40 × 40 cm · 2025
description_html:
Mirror is a digital self-portrait confronting erosion from within. The violet haze rising from the hollow eye embodies illness — quiet, invasive, unrelenting. Threaded through it, fine golden strands mark the brief resistance of creative thought, flickering against decay.

Created in 2025 as part of The Existentialist series, it observes endurance without sentiment — the mind shaping form even as it fades.
dedication_html: For those who create light from the residue of pain.
